answer: Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the umber checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. The yarrow graph is rebuilt each epoch, thus the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the ocean audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 8 times its size, so a group of 89 keys loses far more than 89 single identities would. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
